design_philosophy.visual_style: Clean, airy, high-end editorial. Generous whitespace, glassmorphism overlays, and vivid imagery.

primary.description: Deep Ocean Navy - Use for primary buttons, headers, and text emphasis.

secondary.description: Sunset Coral - Use for CTAs, accents, and highlights.

success.description: Emerald Green - Mandatory for confirmations and availability.

buttons.primary: bg-[#0F2C59] text-white hover:bg-[#0F2C59]/90 rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-lg font-medium transition-all duration-300 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-1
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-[#0F2C59] border border-[#0F2C59]/20 hover:border-[#0F2C59] rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-lg font-medium transition-all duration-300
buttons.accent: bg-[#FF7F50] text-white hover:bg-[#FF7F50]/90 rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-lg font-medium shadow-lg hover:shadow-orange-500/25 transition-all duration-300

cards.experience_card: group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-white shadow-sm hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-500 border border-gray-100
cards.glass_panel: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border border-white/50 shadow-2xl rounded-3xl

inputs.default: h-12 rounded-xl border-gray-200 focus:border-[#0F2C59] focus:ring-[#0F2C59]/20 bg-white/50 backdrop-blur-sm

guidelines.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
guidelines.hover: Cards should lift slightly (-4px) and cast a softer shadow.
guidelines.transitions: Use 'ease-out' curves (0.2s to 0.4s). Avoid linear transitions.
guidelines.parallax: Apply subtle parallax to the hero image and section backgrounds.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text on image backgrounds has a subtle gradient overlay or text-shadow.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus rings in primary blue color.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. COMPONENTS: Use Shadcn UI for the 'Booking Widget' (Calendar, Popover, Select). Customize them to match the 'Jola Blue' theme.
3. HERO SECTION: Implement the provided Hero Image with a 'Glassmorphism' booking widget floating on top (bottom-center or right-aligned).
4. CARDS: Build 'Viator-style' cards for experiences: Image on top (aspect-video), Title, Rating (Stars), Duration, and Price (in MXN) at the bottom.
5. FLEET: Create a horizontal scrollable list for the fleet. Each boat card should show capacity and 'Starting from' price.
6. FORMS: The reservation flow must be intuitive. Step 1: Select Experience/Boat. Step 2: Date & Time. Step 3: Guest Count. Step 4: Payment.
7. TESTING: Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, and cards.
8. FILE EXTENSIONS: Use .jsx for all React components.
universal_guidelines: Do not use generic gradients. Use solid colors or subtle noise textures.
Avoid 'Inter' font for headings. Use 'Playfair Display'.
Ensure mobile responsiveness is prioritized (stack grids to 1 column on mobile).
